sources.excerpt: Red Army Overdrive – Stomp Under Foot Skip to content Search Search Cart PRODUCTS CONTACT FAQ DEALERS ARTISTS ABOUT BLOG Skip to product information Previous Next Close RED ARMY™ VINTAGE MINI Regular price $279.99 By Stomp Under Foot Quantity Add to cart LIMITED EDITION The rare Mike Matthews Red Army Overdrive was the first fuzz pedal produced under the Sovtek name in Russia, circa 1990. Sonically, the Red Army stands apart from other Russian Big Muffs. It offers slightly less low end than the Civil War that followed and delivers a grittier, more aggressive fuzz that is closer in texture to the later Green Russian, but with its own raw character. In my opinion, it's one of the most distinctive and best sounding versions of the Russian Muffs ever made. sources.excerpt: Red Army by Stomp Under Foot | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE Stomp Under Foot Red Army LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS DISTORTION OVERDRIVE Description This is based on the very rare Mike Matthews Red Army Overdrive. This was the first Big Muff from the Sovtek line. It sounds in between the Green Russian and the Civil War muffs. It has a smoothness almost like the Civil War but retains a bit of grit like the Green Russian. It's a great mix of the two.
